content.text:
## Scope note

“RootMC Official” spans two layers:

1. **Discord bot + Worker cron** (`DISCORD_ROOTMC_BOT_TOKEN` via `rootmc-realm-api`) — most player-facing automations  
2. **Paper plugin `rootmc-official`** — peer progression sync + hourly server-log upload (not slash commands)

`notes/rootmc-bot-parity.md` does not exist yet; natural home is `Server Handoffs/Ava Ivy/notes/rootmc-bot-parity.md`.

---

## Official capabilities (with paths)

### A. Discord bot / Worker (`DISCORD_ROOTMC_BOT_TOKEN`)

| Capability | Paths |
|---|---|
| Slash cmds: `/help` `/link` `/server` `/value` `/worth` `/balance` `/bal` `/pay` `/vote` `/proposal(s)` `/systemreport` `/devuptime` | `Web Files/rootmc-realm-api/src/discord-rootmc-bot.ts` · interactions `realm-router.ts` → `POST /v1/discord/rootmc/interactions` |
| Proposal vote **buttons** (legacy path still wired) | `rootmc-community-proposals.ts` (`handleProposalVoteButton`, `VOTE_PREFIX`) · dispatched from `discord-rootmc-bot.ts` |
| Proposal create / threads / weekly bill → #voting | `rootmc-community-proposals.ts` · `rootmc-legislature.ts` |
| Seed ✅/❌/➖ on poll open (prefers Ava token) | `rootmc-community-proposals.ts` (`seedVoteStartReactions`, `AVA_DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN`) |
| Timezone role selects | `discord-rootmc-bot.ts` (`TIMEZONE_COMPONENT_IDS`) |
| Daily reports (midnight HST) + category briefs | `rootmc-daily-report.ts` · `rootmc-daily-category-reports.ts` · `rootmc-daily-combined.ts` · cron `realm-index.ts` |
| Weekly summaries + activity awards | `rootmc-weekly-reports.ts` · `rootmc-weekly-activity-awards.ts` |
| Monthly activity dividend report | `rootmc-monthly-dividend-report.ts` · cron in `realm-index.ts` |
| **Automated reports board** (live last-run index in `#automated-reports`) | `rootmc-automated-reports-board.ts` · refresh after posts + hourly in `realm-index.ts` · seed script `scripts/seed-automated-reports-board.mjs` · channel IDs `rootmc-report-channels.ts` |
| Hourly Gen1+Gen2 economy/realm snapshot | `rootmc-live-economy-status.ts` · cron `realm-index.ts` (`runLiveEconomyStatusPost`) |
| Discord activity sync / scoring | `rootmc-discord-activity-sync.ts` · `rootmc-activity-scoring.ts` |
| Slack mirror of intelligence reports | `rootmc-slack-report-mirror.ts` → Slack `#server-reports` |
| Channel inventory / ops map | `scripts/post-rootmc-discord-operations-report.mjs` · `wrangler.toml` `DISCORD_ROOTMC_*` |

### B. Paper plugin `rootmc-official`

| Capability | Paths |
|---|---|
| Peer MySQL progression sync (playtime, votes, activity, etc.) | `Plugin Building/Minecraft/plugins/rootmc-official/.../ProgressionSyncService.java` · `OfficialConfig.java` · `rootmc-official.yml` |
| **Hourly server-log relay** → Slack webhook / Discord server-logs | `.../OfficialHourlyLogRelay.java` · gated by `server-log-sync.enabled` |
| Admin `/rootmcofficial` | `.../OfficialCommand.java` |

### C. In-game pipes that feed Official/Ava (not the Discord bot itself)

| Capability | Paths |
|---|---|
| `/proposal` → queue for Ava (64 G) | `root-play/.../ProposalCommand.java` · API `rootmc-ingame-proposal.ts` |
| `/feedback` → Slack `#feedback` + Ava inbox | `root-play`/`roothelp` `FeedbackCommand.java` · `rootmc-ingame-feedback.ts` · `feedback-route-rootmc.ts` |
| `/vote` + open-proposal notify (+3 G) | `root-play/.../VoteCommand.java` · `ProposalNotifyService.java` |
| `/report` tickets | `root-ops/.../ReportService.java` · `rootmc-ingame-report.ts` |
| Chat bridge / Core Discord | `root-core` / `root-discord` comms |

---

## Ava already covers (with paths)

| Area | What Ava does | Paths |
|---|---|---|
| **Proposals** | Drains in-game idea queue; formalizes PROP + Discord thread | `proposalIdeas.mjs` · `governanceClient.mjs` · polled from `poller.mjs` / wake in `pipeline.mjs` · API `rootmc-ingame-proposal.ts` |
| **Feedback** | Drains `/feedback` queue; acks; optional Discord digest; points feature asks at `/proposal` | `feedbackInbox.mjs` · `governanceClient.mjs` |
| **Voting** | Text votes in `#voting` (`for`/`against`/`abstain`); forwards via API | `voteText.mjs` · `pipeline.mjs` |
| **Poll watcher** | Seeds ✅/❌/➖; auto-casts Ava seat; gate notes / stage jobs | `pollWatcher.mjs` |
| **Reaction → vote factors** | Syncs reactor quality into D1 | `governanceClient.mjs` (`pushReactorVoteFactorsToApi`) · API `rootmc-governance-routes.ts` |
| **Player help (conversational)** | Balance/status/wiki/vote guidance via chat (not slash cmds) | `surfaceRules.mjs` · `persona.mjs` · `recommend.mjs` · `pipeline.mjs` |
| **Onboarding** | Join welcome + DM | `onboarding.mjs` |
| **Changelog / ship notes** | Posts to changelog channel | `changelog.mjs` · `jobQueue.mjs` |
| **RSS / updates** | Feed watch → updates channel | `rssWatch.mjs` |
| **Ops awareness** | Reads Slack `automated-reports` / `server-logs` / `feedback` dumps | `channelDump.mjs` |
| **Post style** | Splits long posts like Official reports | `splitContent.mjs` |
| **Identity posts** | `AVA_*_BOT_TOKEN` via `avaPost.mjs` | `avaPost.mjs` |
| Explicit non-retire until parity | Urgent registry item | `urgentTelegram.mjs` · Ava Ivy urgent notes |

---

## Gaps Ava still needs (parity blockers)

Keep Official until these are owned or intentionally left on Worker-as-infrastructure:

1. **Slash-command surface** — `/link` `/server` `/value` `/balance` `/pay` `/vote` `/proposal` `/systemreport` `/devuptime` / timezone selects (`discord-rootmc-bot.ts`)  
2. **Scheduled intelligence posts** — daily/weekly category + combined reports, weekly awards, monthly dividend (Worker cron; Ava does not author/post these)  
3. **Automated reports board** — create/edit Discord board message (`rootmc-automated-reports-board.ts`); Slack canvas is ops mirror only  
4. **Hourly realm snapshots** — `runLiveEconomyStatusPost`; open ask to include pending proposals  
5. **Hourly Paper log uploads** — still `OfficialHourlyLogRelay` via Root-Core/Slack (not Ava)  
6. **Button-vote fallback** — still on Official interactions; Ava is text-only by design  
7. **Player economy actions in Discord** — `/pay` / `/balance` / `/value` charts have no Ava-command equivalent  
8. **`/systemreport` staff trigger** — Official-only  
9. **Link-complete / awards / season pings** written as Official bot posts — Ava onboards conversationally but does not replace those cron writes  

**Already Ava-primary (not gaps):** in-game `/proposal` formalize, `/feedback` drain, text voting + reaction seed + Ava council ballot.

---

## Suggested checklist for `notes/rootmc-bot-parity.md`

```markdown
# RootMC Official vs Ava — bot parity

## Do not kick Official until
- [ ] Document which automations stay Worker-owned forever (cron reports, board, hourly snapshots)
- [ ] vs which must move to Ava before retire

## Governance (Ava-led — verify live)
- [ ] In-game /proposal queue drains while Ava online (+ offline catch-up on boot)
- [ ] Formal PROP + #proposals thread + poll appear without Official slash
- [ ] #voting text votes record weighted ballots (+3 G once)
- [ ] Poll watcher seeds ✅/❌/➖ and Ava auto-vote
- [ ] /feedback queue acked; Slack #feedback still staff copy
- [ ] Buttons retired or ignored; no double-count with text

## Player Discord commands (Official today)
- [ ] /help /link /server parity or deliberate Ava chat equivalents
- [ ] /balance /pay /value|/worth (Gold, charts) — keep Official or reimplement
- [ ] /vote power summary + poll links
- [ ] /proposal Discord path vs in-game-only policy
- [ ] Timezone role select — keep Official or drop

## Reports & board (Worker today)
- [ ] Daily combined + economy/towns/nations still post
- [ ] Weekly suite + activity awards
- [ ] Monthly Activity Dividend
- [ ] #automated-reports board refreshes (or Slack-only + Discord retired by decision)
- [ ] Slack #server-reports mirror still fires
- [ ] Hourly snapshots: pending-proposals block decision

## Host / logs
- [ ] Hourly Paper log relay (rootmc-official) → Slack #server-logs
- [ ] Chat bridge stays Root-Core (not Official Discord app)
- [ ] /report ticket channels remain Worker+plugin

## Retire gate
- [ ] Ava online ≥ N days covering proposal+feedback+votes without Official
- [ ] Operator sign-off on Worker-kept cron list
- [ ] Only then remove/disable Official Discord application from guild
```

---

**Bottom line:** Ava already owns the governance intake loop Official used to own (proposals, feedback, text votes). Parity to retire Official is mostly **slash economy/status**, **cron report authorship + board**, and **hourly snapshots/logs** — or an explicit decision that those stay Worker forever under Official’s token.
